for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pair[i]=j; pair[j]=i

def fold(seq):
    s,mfe=RNA.fold(seq)
    return s,mfe

def spairs(s):
    st=[]; sp=[-1]*n
    for i,c in enumerate(s):
        if c=='(': st.append(i)
        elif c==')':
            j=st.pop(); sp[i]=j; sp[j]=i
    return sp

def bpdist(s):
    sp=spairs(s)
    miss=sum(1 for i in range(n) if pair[i]!=-1 and sp[i]!=pair[i])
    spur=sum(1 for i in range(n) if sp[i]!=-1 and pair[i]!=sp[i])
    return (miss+spur)//2

seed=int(sys.argv[1])
start=sys.argv[2]
random.seed(seed)

bs,bmfe=fold(start)
bd=bpdist(bs)
best=start; cur=start; curd=bd
print(f'[{seed}] start dist',bd,file=sys.stderr)

it=0

            ch=random.choice([('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A')])
            if i<j:

            else:

    T*=0.9999

sys.stdout.write(best+'\n')
